title: A median degree from crossing graphs of median graphs
summary: The crossing graph $\mathrm{Cross}(M)$ of a median graph $M$ is defined as the graph whose vertices are the $Θ$-classes of $M$ and whose edges connect two $Θ$-classes whenever they cross. It is known that every graph $X$ can be realised as the crossing graph of some median graph. In this article, we initiate the study of the space $\mathrm{Cross}^{-1}(X)$ of all the median graphs with crossing graph $X$. First, we prove that two finite median graphs have isomorphic crossing graphs if and only if one can be obtained from the other by a sequence of elementary transformations we call slidings.…
